performance.verdict: Meta working at $50.99 CPL; Google burning $975/lead — reallocation overdue.

findings.text: Meta: 36 leads at $50.99 CPL ($1,835.81 spend). Google: 2 conversions at ~$974.62 CPL ($1,949.23 spend). A 19x CPL gap is a confirmed budget misallocation.
6 SOW milestones overdue since Jul–Aug 2026: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting, and Shoot 1. All unresolved.
GHL shows 105 opportunities from 320 contacts, 0 won, 0 appointments. Leads arriving but no pipeline conversion — this is an intake/CRM gap, not an ads problem.
3-day lead signal (Oct 27–29): 2, 1, 2 leads vs prior 3 days (Oct 24–26): 3, 0, 2. Volume flat; Meta spend last 3 days averaged $76.85/day — efficiency holding but not accelerating.
GBP actions fell 61.36% week-over-week; last 3 days (Oct 27–29) show 1, 0, 0 actions vs 5, 1, 0 prior. Organic local visibility declining while paid spend continues.

suggestions.text: Shift $20/day from Google Search to Meta — Google is at ~$975 CPL vs Meta's ~$51.
suggestions.monday_update: Reduce Google Search daily budget by $20/day and add the same to Meta, based on a confirmed 19x CPL gap ($974.62 Google vs $50.99 Meta over 28 days). This is a step-shift, not a full pause — Google retains budget while we monitor the 2 conversions. Success check: Meta CPL stays below $70 and Google CPL shows improvement or Google delivers 2+ more conversions within 14 days. Re-evaluate by 2026-11-13.

suggestions.text: Escalate 0-appointment, 0-won pipeline in GHL — 105 open opps with no booked consults signals intake breakdown.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 105 opportunities created from 320 contacts with 0 won and 0 appointments booked — leads are entering the system but no consult is being scheduled. Audit the routing, auto-reply, and calendar booking setup per the Month 1 SOW deliverables (speed-to-lead under 5 min, missed-call-text-back, booking link). Success check: at least 5 appointments booked within 7 days of fix going live. Flag to Nacer immediately.

suggestions.text: Watch Google Search: if 0 additional conversions by Nov 6, escalate to kill or deeper budget shift.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has produced only 2 conversions on $1,949.23 over 28 days (~$975 CPL). The 3-day trend shows Google spend declining (Oct 27–29 avg $43.31/day) with no corresponding leads. Hold full pause until Nov 6 — if no additional conversions surface by then, recommend killing or near-zeroing the Search budget in favor of Meta. Note: SOW LSA launch is also overdue and may explain Google underperformance.
